name: Monday.com
description: monday.com's developer platform offers a GraphQL platform API, apps framework, webhooks and a hosted MCP server.
auth_notes: Personal V2 API tokens sent in the Authorization header; app tokens with scopes via OAuth2.
gate_detail: A free developer account gives an API token for testing; personal tokens mirror the user's UI permissions. Dynamic MCP connectors need admin approval.
api_scope: GraphQL platform API for workflows and data, plus apps with UI extensions, hosting, webhooks and agents.
mcp_notes: Hosted Platform MCP server maintained by the monday.com AI team; separate Apps MCP exists for building apps.
blocker_detail: Token access mirrors user permissions; only extra MCP connectors require admin approval.

evidence.quote: The monday.com platform API utilizes personal V2 API tokens to authenticate requests and identify the user making the call.
create a free developer account to get an API token and start testing.
